title: RPG Premium
game_overview: A top-down action roguelite where warriors battle through mechanical, mystical, martial, and cosmic biomes to defeat formidable guardians.
winning_condition: Defeat the overseers across all four biomes and extinguish the Paradox Monarch in the Interdimensional Rift.
losing_condition: The player hero loses all health points in combat.

controls.input: W / A / S / D or Arrow Keys / Virtual Joystick
controls.action: Move the player hero omnidirectionally through the arena.

controls.input: Mouse Left Click / Spacebar / Primary Touch Button
controls.action: Execute primary weapon attack or cast equipped skill.

controls.input: Mouse Right Click / Shift / Dash Touch Button
controls.action: Perform high-speed evasive dash with invulnerability frames.
Switch equipped weapon archetype or activate secondary ability.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Kinetic Combat Readability: Fast-paced action with distinct attack telegraphs, sharp pixel silhouettes, and responsive dodge frames. 2. Biome Identity & Synergy: 4 distinct world phases (Robotic, Jade, Scarlet Fortress, Interdimensional Rift) featuring unique enemies, combat VFX, and terrain props. 3. Roguelite Mastery: Progressive difficulty scaling, weapon switching, and satisfying boss encounters.
sections.summary: Core foundational pillars of fast combat and visual excellence.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: Enter Biome Arena -> Evade enemy telegraphs & execute weapon combos -> Clear enemy waves & collect power essence -> Face the biome overseer boss -> Progress to the next fractured dimension -> Defeat the Paradox Monarch to secure victory.
sections.summary: The room-clearing, upgrade-gathering, and boss-slaying progression cycle.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. 3/4 Oblique Omnidirectional Combat: Fluid 360-degree aiming and 8-directional movement. 2. Active Telegraph Dodging: Red and cyan floor warning zones signal incoming heavy impacts, allowing players to time their dash i-frames. 3. Elemental Weapon Swapping: Switching between rapid blasters, heavy halberds, mystical staves, and rift blades. 4. Biome Modifiers: Environmental hazards like electrified tiles, root snares, and gravity pulses.
sections.summary: Key interactive systems driving combat and exploration.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Multi-Directional / Free-roaming arena. Asset Orientation Baseline: Oblique 3/4 top-down view with Flip-Rigid rendering where right-facing sprites flip along X-axis when maneuvering left. Movement Physics: Responsive acceleration with minimal drift for precise combat dodging. Camera Behavior: Smooth soft-deadzone camera tracking centering the active player avatar.
sections.summary: Oblique top-down movement and camera parameters.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer Separation: Desaturated, low-contrast floor tiles and background structures sit on the lower z-plane with zero collision interference. The playfield layer contains high-contrast pixel characters, vibrant weapons, and glowing projectile VFX. Obstacle Affordance: Environmental barricades, pillars, and hazards have distinct highlight borders to clearly define impassable collision boxes. HUD: Sleek health and energy meters anchored cleanly to the top-left margin with adaptive opacity.
sections.summary: Strict contrast and plane separation guidelines.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: Robotic Phase: Spark Drone (agile ranged harasser), Shock Trooper (bipedal rifle bot), Assembly Overseer (mechanized mega boss). Jade Phase: Jade Stalker (stealth melee predator), Stone Guardian (armored juggernaut), Emerald Warden (sacred blade master boss). Scarlet Fortress: Scarlet Duelist (fencing champion), Ember Hound (flame beast), Crimson Castellan (warplate warlord boss). Interdimensional Rift: Rift Skitter (void crawler), Void Lancer (warp skirmisher), Paradox Monarch (reality-warping cosmic ruler boss).
sections.summary: Comprehensive roster across four thematic biomes.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: Telegraph floor projections with escalating fill gauges before lethal attacks; distinctive audio-visual hit-stop effects upon taking damage; brief post-damage invulnerability flash.
sections.summary: Player assistance and visual clarity systems.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Weapon windup sprite flash and floor charging circles. State Change Juice: Dash trail ghosting, glowing particle bursts on elemental triggers. Impact Juice: Tiered screen-shake on boss hits, freeze-frame hit-stops (40ms), and crisp pixel spark explosions.
sections.summary: Sensory feedback across all gameplay moments.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Targeted at fans of high-octane 2D action roguelites, featuring speedrun timers and biome high-score leaderboards.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: High-contrast visual mode for telegraphs, customizable screen shake intensity, and full keyboard/mouse/touch input remapping.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Title Screen -> Biome Selector / Run Start -> Room Combat Loop -> Boss Arena -> Run Summary & Persistent Upgrades.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Conditional mobile rendering using responsive breakpoints. Renders a Virtual D-Pad on bottom-left and Action/Dash buttons on bottom-right. Buttons have touch-none CSS, pointer-events-auto on interactive elements, and robust onPointerUp/onPointerLeave/onPointerCancel handlers.
sections.summary: Touch control overlay for mobile devices.
